Class BankAccountRegistrationControllerTest

@IsTest()
private class BankAccountRegistrationControllerTest

Tests for BankAccountRegistrationController. Exercises the constructor's code-parameter handling (missing, invalid, already-entered, valid placeholder), the register() action's client-side input validation (routing-number format, account- number format and confirmation), and the Mercury service-call outcomes (success, plain-text routing error, JSON account-number error, generic JSON error logged on the placeholder).

Change Log

  • 08/09/2021 - v1.0 - Initial version.
  • 08/09/2021 - v1.1 - Tests when uses own address if present.
  • 08/30/2021 - v1.2 - Bank account records are now generated using the TestDataFactory.TestBankAccount class.
  • 09/11/2021 - v1.3 - TestData.setSettingsForRequests() not used anymore.
  • 10/09/2025 - v1.4 - Updated to use UUID.randomUUID(). API version updated to 64.0.
  • 05/09/2026 - v1.5 - Apply test conventions (TestFor, Assert.* migration); bump API to 66.0. Test methods now run as the guest user.

  Modifiers and Type Name Description
private static void
controllerAccountCodeError1Test()
Verifies the constructor sets errorMessage to MY_Error_BankInfoEntered when the placeholder loaded by code is not in waiting status — i.e., bank information has already been entered for that record.
private static void
controllerAccountCodeError2Test()
Verifies the constructor sets errorMessage to the MY_Error_BankCodeInvalid label when the supplied code does not match any BankAccount__c.Code__c.
private static void
controllerAccountCodeError3Test()
Verifies the constructor sets errorMessage to the MY_Error_BankCodeMissing label when the page is opened without a code parameter.
private static void
controllerTest()
Verifies the happy path: the controller loads a waiting placeholder by code, the register() action calls MercuryService with the form values, and the placeholder is updated with the service-issued ExternalId__c, Status__c, and BankName__c.
private static void
registrationAccountCodeErrorTest()
Verifies that register() short-circuits and returns null when an account-code error has already been raised (no Mercury callout, no DML).
private static void
registrationBankAccountErrorsTest()
Walks through every client-side validation branch in register(): non-numeric routing number, wrong-length routing number, missing account number, missing confirmation, non-numeric account number, and account/confirmation mismatch.
private static void
registrationServiceError1Test()
Verifies that a Mercury 400 with a plain-text invalid routing number body is mapped to the MY_Error_ServiceError1 label and surfaced via errorMessage.
private static void
registrationServiceError2Test()
Verifies that a Mercury 400 with a JSON {"message": "invalid accountnumber"} body is mapped to the MY_Error_ServiceError2 label and surfaced via errorMessage.
private static void
registrationServiceError4Test()
Verifies that a Mercury 400 with a generic JSON error body (anything not matched as routing or account-number) results in the message being persisted on the placeholder BankAccount__c.Message__c for follow-up.
private static void
setup()
Provisions a guest-style user assigned the BlazeBite Bank Account Registration Profile and aliased RegGuest, so each test method can invoke the controller via System.runAs(...) and exercise it under the same profile that hosts the public Visualforce page in the org.
